instructions: For each proposal return one verdict object: {proposal_id, verdict: accept|reject|modify|defer|hold_for_human, payload (required if modify), rationale}. Reject anything whose pattern could match a DIFFERENT food — an over-broad alias lets a wrong product take a price, which is the failure this board exists to prevent. Prefer reject over accept when uncertain; a missed alias costs one empty cell. Mark hold_for_human when the change is broad or the evidence is thin.
